# Class result and independent Throwable factory scope

An owned generic receiver returns its own Object-bounded class formal while a
separate method-owned Throwable formal controls a binary Function producer and
the original throws slot. Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice with source
and SDK receivers, including an owned covariant future override. Direct and
same-receiver delegation, lazy factories, context/receiver/result identities,
null and wrong values, partial writes, late casts and exact checked/runtime/error
objects remain observable. Every generated source, original method and metadata
entry is compiled and audited. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving
Signature controls guard the scope proof. Only owned classes execute.
